entries.description: Compared template-seed workflow assets with the accepted app baseline, compatibility notes, and template guardrails using routed analysis to confirm the current seed stays workflow-focused and aligned by omission.

Ran a constrained routed defaults review to identify the workflow-doc, instruction-template, and starter-session guidance changes Session 2 should make without turning template-seed into an application scaffold.

Created docs/planning/notes-driven-template-contract-audit.md to record the template contract verdict, Session 2 update list, explicit limitations, and risks to avoid while keeping template-seed workflow-focused.

Ran dotnet build and dotnet test for Dabbler.Platform.sln. The initial parallel attempt hit MSBuild file-lock contention, then the required sequential rerun succeeded with build passing and all 366 tests passing.
Sent the Session 1 planning artifact, activity log, spec excerpt, and sequential build/test results to external session verification and saved the raw review output.
